title: Naaman Healed of Leprosy

questions.question: Who was Naaman?
options: Commander of the army of the king of Syria
questions.correctAnswer: Commander of the army of the king of Syria
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:1 (ESV): "Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man..."

questions.question: Who suggested Naaman go to the prophet in Samaria?
options: A little girl from Israel who was a servant
questions.correctAnswer: A little girl from Israel who was a servant
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:2-3 (ESV): "...a little girl from the land of Israel... She said to her mistress, 'Would that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria!...'"

questions.question: What did Elisha tell Naaman to do?
options: Wash in the Jordan seven times
questions.correctAnswer: Wash in the Jordan seven times
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:10 (ESV): "...Go and wash in the Jordan seven times..."

questions.question: What happened to Gehazi?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:27 (ESV): "Therefore the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you... So he went out from his presence a leper..."

questions.question: Why was Naaman angry at Elisha's instruction?
options: He expected Elisha to come out and wave his hand over the place
questions.correctAnswer: He expected Elisha to come out and wave his hand over the place
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:11 (ESV): "But Naaman was angry... behold, I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call upon the name of the LORD... and wave his hand over the place..."

questions.question: What rivers did Naaman say were better than the Jordan?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:12 (ESV): "Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?"

questions.question: What did Naaman ask for after being healed?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:17 (ESV): "Then Naaman said, 'If not, please let there be given to your servant two mules' load of earth...'"

questions.question: Why did Gehazi run after Naaman?
options: To take something from him (silver and clothing)
questions.correctAnswer: To take something from him (silver and clothing)
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:20 (ESV): "...I will run after him and take something from him."

questions.question: How much did Gehazi ask for in Elisha's name?
options: A talent of silver and two changes of clothing
questions.correctAnswer: A talent of silver and two changes of clothing
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:22 (ESV): "...Give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing."

questions.question: Who convinced Naaman to follow Elisha's instructions?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:13 (ESV): "But his servants came near and said to him, 'My father, it is a great word the prophet has spoken to you; will you not do it?'"

questions.question: Did Elisha accept Naaman's gift?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:16 (ESV): "But he said, 'As the LORD lives... I will receive none.' And he urged him to take it, but he refused."

questions.question: What made the King of Israel tear his clothes?
options: The letter from the King of Syria asking to cure Naaman
questions.correctAnswer: The letter from the King of Syria asking to cure Naaman
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:7 (ESV): "And when the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, 'Am I God... that this man sends word to me to cure a man of his leprosy?'"

questions.question: Naaman asked for pardon when he bowed in the temple of which god?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:18 (ESV): "...when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there..."

questions.question: What did Elisha say to Gehazi about his spirit?
options: Did not my heart go when the man turned from his chariot to meet you?
questions.correctAnswer: Did not my heart go when the man turned from his chariot to meet you?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 5:26 (ESV): "But he said to him, 'Did not my heart go when the man turned from his chariot to meet you?'"

key_verse_text: Then he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and he came and stood before him. And he said, “Behold, I know that there is no God in all the earth but in Israel; so accept now a present from your servant.” (ESV)
